<bookmark mark='c2'/>Cut the square at the split. There are four pieces, not two.

narration: <bookmark mark='k1'/>To check, multiply the long way. One hundred four times one hundred is ten thousand four hundred.
<bookmark mark='k2'/>One hundred four times four is four hundred sixteen. Together they make ten thousand eight hundred sixteen.
<bookmark mark='k3'/>Check thirty seven times thirty seven the same way.
